options.cost_hint: Usually no extra cost if booked through a reputable platform with accessibility guarantees; otherwise, may depend on new hotel rates.

findings.text: Accessibility details for restaurants and attractions (The Fisherman’s Wharf, Ritz Classic, Goa Science Centre, Miramar Beach) are not fully confirmed. Some venues in Goa may have steps, narrow entrances, or inaccessible restrooms even if generally considered accessible.
findings.fix: Contact each venue directly before travel to confirm step-free access, accessible restrooms, and any ramps or assistance available.

findings.text: Tight transfer times between flight arrival, taxi, and hotel check-in may be stressful if there are delays or if airport assistance is missing. Wheelchair assistance at airports can sometimes be slow or unavailable.
findings.fix: Request wheelchair assistance in advance with both airlines and airports. Allow extra time for transfers, and have contact numbers for airport assistance and taxi service ready.

findings.text: Long distances between venues and possible traffic in Goa may cause fatigue, especially in hot weather. The schedule has limited rest breaks on Day 1.
findings.fix: Build in flexible rest periods, especially after travel and before meals. Consider reducing the number of activities or allowing more time between them.

findings.text: Heat and humidity in Goa can cause discomfort or health issues for wheelchair users, especially outdoors at the beach or during transfers.
findings.fix: Plan for hydration, sun protection, and accessible shaded areas. Avoid outdoor activities during peak heat (midday).
